statements.t: Management intends to seek to continue the Loyalty Program for enrolled holders following delisting, including by amending the CVR Agreement to measure the price thresholds on the principal market on which the common stock is then listed or quoted.

At its annual meeting on August 7, 2026, the Company’s stockholders approved an increase in authorized common stock from 100,000,000 to 250,000,000 shares, which the Company plans to, but has not yet, effected.
We will bear the expenses incurred in connection with the filing of any such registration statements.
